findings.claim: The new Fast-route plan assigns FT9, FT10 and FT11 a 70-minute Project block but only labels topic pages as project support. It identifies no learner-facing project brief, observable project outcomes, taught-before-application prerequisite map, starter scaffold, or public language-native tests and test command. The direct implementation route therefore cannot be authored or checked for prerequisite alignment, and no canonical project artifact is identified for reuse by the Standard and Fast overlays.

evidence.section: dayTypes.Fast.blocks; Fast days FT9, FT10 and FT11
Sections 1, 3 and 6: starter layout, one language-native test command and public-test behavior

findings.recommendation: Add a canonical learner-facing project-artifact plan for each FT9-FT11 Project row, or explicitly map those rows to successive increments of one reusable brief. For every increment, name observable outcomes, map each applied concept to an objective taught earlier on that route, and identify a runnable starter scaffold, public tests and one language-native test command. Have the Standard and Fast overlays reference the same canonical brief; keep Fast free of the Standard coding lab and use no learner-side container engine, committed solution or hidden test.

Still open on the current bytes. Lines 212-270 now supply one canonical three-increment brief, observable outcomes, 70-minute sums, scaffold/extensions, public pytest tests, offline/native-toolchain constraints, and Standard/Fast reuse. However, the per-requirement table at lines 260-266 says every listed objective is fully exercised while several compound requirements are absent from the minuted steps: lists/dicts o2 (line 101) requires add, look up, update and remove but lines 233-235 do not require removal; slicing/comprehensions o2 (line 105) requires rewriting a loop and building a dict or set comprehension but line 233 explicitly requires only a filtered list comprehension; modules/imports o1 (line 112) requires standard-library and own-module import forms plus explaining module lookup but line 234 teaches only importing from the learner package; generator o2 (line 129) requires explaining the bounded-memory condition but line 243 covers yield and exhaustion only; and FastAPI o2 (line 161) requires path, query and body validation status and error bodies but line 254 checks only one invalid query status. The correction therefore does not yet meet its own per-requirement rule at line 220 or the accepted reconciliation requirement.
